title: Component recipe
description: The only file a human (or an agent) writes per component. Every field is a pick from a closed vocabulary that lives elsewhere: parts from anatomy/<component>.json, roles from roles.json, axes from axes.json.

anatomy.description: Optional. Anatomy file to read; defaults to anatomy/<component lowercased>.json. Needed when the namespace directory is hyphenated (ToggleGroup -> toggle-group.json).

importFrom.description: Package the headless parts are imported from.

importName.description: Namespace imported, e.g. Accordion for `import { Accordion as Headless }`.

adapter.description: Token adapter name; informational, the loaded adapter is authoritative.

axes.description: Axes this component exposes. Names are validated against axes.json by check.mjs.

unstyled.description: part -> anatomy states that deliberately need no declaration (resting states, ARIA-only states, states an ancestor already dims). This is the third answer to the coverage gate: styled, deliberately unstyled, or unanswered. check.mjs validates both directions - a part or state the anatomy does not declare is an error, and declaring a state that a role styles is an error.

parts.description: part -> roles. Authored order IS emission order, which is the cascade contract. Also the reason this is not a closed enum: CORE-IDEA.md's inline role enum would silently reject every role added later, so role/part/axis existence is enforced against the taxonomy files by check.mjs instead. Parts that render no styleable DOM (context providers, component-tagged utility parts) may be omitted; check.mjs requires the rest to be a decision.

items.description: A role name from roles.json. Later roles win on property conflicts.
